structured.answer: I'd go with Harel, the "עוקב מדד S&P 500" track (קופה 13414). It's the S&P thing my friends talk about, Harel is a big name I know, the fee is 0.56% and it shows "13.7%" for 3 years. Mor has the same track but with a higher fee (0.71%).

stuck.why: Every company has 10 to 16 tracks that look almost the same. By Altshuler/Meitav I was bored and stopped scrolling. I never saw the other 7 or so companies.
There's a chip "עוקב מדד S&P 500 12" that would have cut the list down, but on these screens it's "הכל" that's selected, so I had to scroll through everything.
Lots of rows just say "פחות מ־3 שנים" instead of a number, so I couldn't compare those. Some of them have tiny fees.

חשיפה למניות ולמט"ח: the yellow and teal circles, I guess yellow = dollars

"עוד לא דווח" with an orange warning icon
not_found: What the fee means in shekels on my 30,000
How to actually open the fund, i.e. what to do first

findings.what: Way too many near-identical rows. There's no short answer and no fee in shekels
Fee is shown only as a small %, so 0.56% vs 0.71% looks like nothing
Many returns read "פחות מ־3 שנים" so you can't compare those rows
Return is "לפני דמי ניהול", which is easy to miss and makes the numbers look better than they are
Two fee lines (מההיסכון / מההפקדות) with no explanation next to them
Donut colours aren't explained right next to them
